page.overview:
Who is Crimson Guard?

The Crimson Guard was a very short-lived element of the "Brothers of Light" cult, led by the psychic twins Tomax and Xamot.

When most of the Joes were brainwashed, Tomax and Xamot took note of their talents, dressed them in scarlet robes, and introduced them to the rest of their members as the "Crimson Guard". They planned to put them to use expanding their influence across the world.

The "guard" did not last long, as Tunnel Rat and Snake-Eyes managed to bring their friends to their senses a few minutes later. Several minutes after that, the cult was effectively ended. Category:Renegades Characters
